situation: I walk into a party where I only know one person
behavior: I find that one person and stick close to them all night

situation: I have an unexpected free evening
behavior: I am quietly delighted and stay home with a book

situation: I'm in a meeting and an idea pops into my head
behavior: I think it through silently and only speak if asked

situation: I'm waiting in line and the person next to me catches my eye
behavior: I smile briefly and look back at my phone

situation: A friend asks me to host a dinner for ten people
behavior: I make an excuse and suggest a smaller meetup instead

situation: I have a long stretch alone with no plans
behavior: I settle in happily and don't feel the need to reach out

situation: Someone tells a story to a small group
behavior: I listen attentively and don't add my own

situation: I'm asked to give a toast on short notice
behavior: I freeze briefly then say a single short sentence

situation: I see a group laughing across the room
behavior: I notice and stay where I am

situation: I finish a long focused work session
behavior: I want quiet and time to myself before anything else
